name: CES615 · 拖把故障与风速限制

cards.taskTitle: 31. CES615 · 拖把故障与风速限制-1
cards.audioText: You are CES615, from Wuhan to Shanghai Hongqiao airport. Gate 232, Information S, ask for ATC clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: 你是东方615，从武汉飞往上海虹桥机场。232号机位，通播S，请求ATC放行。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES615, information S, destination Shanghai Hongqiao, request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，东方615，通播S，目的地上海虹桥机场，请求ATC放行。

cards.taskTitle: 31. CES615 · 拖把故障与风速限制-2
cards.audioText: CES615, Wuhan Delivery, cleared to Shanghai Hongqiao via flight planned route, runway 36R, ZF-01 departure, initial climb 1800m, cruising level 10100m, after departure contact 123.4, squawk 4125.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方615，武汉放行，可以按计划航路飞往上海虹桥机场，跑道36右，ZF-01离场，起始高度1800米，巡航高度10100米，起飞后联系123.4，应答机4125。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Shanghai Hongqiao, via flight planned route, runway 36R, ZF-01 departure, initial climb 1800m, cruising level 10100m, departure 123.4, squawk 4125, CES615.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以按计划航路飞往上海虹桥机场，跑道36右，ZF-01离场，起始高度1800米，巡航高度10100米，离场后联系123.4，应答机4125，东方615。

cards.taskTitle: 31. CES615 · 拖把故障与风速限制-3
cards.audioText: You found that the tow bar was not available, contact Ground for the tow bar.
cards.audioTextZh: 你发现牵引杆无法使用，联系地面要一个新的。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES615, request a new tow bar due the tow bar not available.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，东方615，牵引杆不能使用，请求提供一个新的。

cards.taskTitle: 31. CES615 · 拖把故障与风速限制-4
cards.audioText: CES615, roger. Tow bar is on the way.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方615，收到。牵引杆马上送到。

cards.taskTitle: 31. CES615 · 拖把故障与风速限制-5
cards.audioText: You have already pushback and start-up, tell Ground you can taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: 你已经推出开车，告诉地面你可以滑行了。
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，东方615，请求滑行。

cards.taskTitle: 31. CES615 · 拖把故障与风速限制-6
cards.audioText: CES615, taxi via Z4, A3, A to the holding point of A7.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方615，沿滑行道Z4，A3，A滑至滑行道A7的等待点。
cards.referenceText: Z4, A3, A to the holding point of A7, CES615.
cards.referenceTextZh: 沿滑行道Z4，A3，A滑至滑行道A7的等待点，东方615。

cards.taskTitle: 31. CES615 · 拖把故障与风速限制-7
cards.audioText: CES615, two cranes erected west of taxiway A, taxi with caution.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方615，滑行道A西侧有2辆起重机，小心滑行。

cards.taskTitle: 31. CES615 · 拖把故障与风速限制-8
cards.audioText: CES615, give way to A320 on A7. When it is clear, continue taxi to A, hold short of runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方615，给滑行道A7上的A320让路。没影响后，继续滑行至滑行道A，跑道36右外等待。
cards.referenceText: Give way to the traffic on A7, after traffic cleared, taxi to A, hold short of runway 36R, CES615.
cards.referenceTextZh: 给滑行道A7上的A320让路。飞机没影响后，继续滑至滑行道A，跑道36右外等待，东方615。

cards.taskTitle: 31. CES615 · 拖把故障与风速限制-9
cards.audioText: The wind sock indicates strong tailwind, ask Tower to check the wind.
cards.audioTextZh: 风袋显示有强烈顺风，让塔台查看风向风速。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES615, request wind check.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，东方615，核实风向风速。

cards.taskTitle: 31. CES615 · 拖把故障与风速限制-10
cards.audioText: CES615, current wind 350 degrees at 6mps.[The wind is excess the company regulation of the takeoff wind speed; tell the controller you need to change the runway 36L.]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方615，当前风350，6米/秒。【该风速超过公司规定的起飞风速；告诉管制员你需要更换至跑道36左。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES615, the wind excesses the company regulation. Request change runway 36L.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，东方615，该风速超过公司规定。请求更换至跑道36左。

cards.taskTitle: 31. CES615 · 拖把故障与风速限制-11
cards.audioText: CES615, change runway 36L approved, taxi to holding point 36L, via A, A2 and Z2.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方615，可以更换至跑道36左，沿滑行道A，A2，Z2滑行至跑道36左等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point 36L, via A, A2 and Z2, CES615.
cards.referenceTextZh: 沿滑行道A，A2，Z2滑至跑道36左等待点，东方615。

cards.taskTitle: 31. CES615 · 拖把故障与风速限制-12
cards.audioText: CES615, the takeoff aircraft ahead reported birds in the vicinity of the airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方615，前方起飞的飞机报告机场附近有鸟群。

cards.taskTitle: 31. CES615 · 拖把故障与风速限制-13
cards.audioText: You encountered bird strike and one of your engines failed, make an urgency call and ask to return to Wuhan airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 你遇到鸟击，一发失效，做紧急呼叫，要求返回武汉机场。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Wuhan Tower, CES615, engine failure due bird strike, request return to Wuhan airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN，武汉塔台，东方615，由于鸟击，发动机失效，请求返回武汉机场。

cards.taskTitle: 31. CES615 · 拖把故障与风速限制-14
cards.audioText: CES615, roger PANPAN, climb and maintain 600m, turn right to join downwind, cleared for ILS approach runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方615，收到PANPAN，上升保持600米，右转加入左三边，可以盲降进近跑道36右。
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 600m, right turn join downwind, ILS approach runway 36R, CES615.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上升保持600米，右转加入左三边，可以盲降进近跑道36右，东方615。

cards.taskTitle: 31. CES615 · 拖把故障与风速限制-15
cards.audioText: Because of strong tailwind, you want to change to runway 36L.
cards.audioTextZh: 【由于强烈顺风，你想更换至跑道36左。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES615, request change to runway 36L due strong tailwind.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，东方615，由于强烈顺风，请求更换至跑道36左。

cards.taskTitle: 31. CES615 · 拖把故障与风速限制-16
cards.audioText: CES615, change to runway 36L approved, maintain 600m, turn right to WHA, contact Approach on 121.7.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方615，同意更换至跑道36左，保持600米，右转直飞WHA，联系进近121.7。
cards.referenceText: Runway 36L approved, maintaining 600m, right turn to WHA, Approach 121.7, CES615.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意跑道36左，保持600米，右转直飞WHA，联系进近121.7，东方615。

cards.taskTitle: 31. CES615 · 拖把故障与风速限制-17
cards.audioText: Tell controller you are maintaining 600m, track fly to WHA on Approach 121.7.
cards.audioTextZh: 告诉管制员你正保持在600米，飞往WHA，进近121.7。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES615, maintaining 600m, direct to WHA.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，东方615，600米保持，直飞WHA。

cards.taskTitle: 31. CES615 · 拖把故障与风速限制-18
cards.audioText: CES615, Wuhan Approach radar contact, climb and maintain 900m, after WHA, fly heading 360, expect radar vectors for ILS approach runway 36L.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方615，武汉进近，雷达已识别，上升保持900米，飞过WHA后，航向360，雷达引导盲降进近跑道36左。
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 900m, after WHA, heading 360, radar vector ILS 36L, CES615.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上升保持900米，飞过WHA后，航向360，雷达引导盲降进近跑道36左，东方615。
